title: Trappers resource pack
description: Makes pistons, observers and other redstone items more bare bones style, makes webs red, makes sting impossible to miss and changes the pickaxe
body:
Makes pistons, observers and other redstone items more bare bones style, makes webs red, makes string impossible to miss on the ground and changes the pickaxes to look like the Cobalt pickaxe style (check out that pack too). It also makes pressure plates and powder snow more obvious. 
Finally, what trapper's pack is complete without the iconic hoplite smelter's pick?
The iron pickaxe has been retextured to become the smelter's pick from the popular trapping server hoplite.
Credit to my good friend kinggeo for the diamond pickaxe design which I used for the rest :D
